Messages.Author: drnlmza
Messages.Body:
> Curef99 wrote:
> any chance you know someone who posted all known errata?
>
There isn't an official list of which cards have been errata'd and which existing printings are incorrect (although, as others have pointed out, the current text is easy to find).

The expansion pages linked from the cardlist - www.vekn.net/card-lists - will mention notable changes in the particular expansion, but that information is scattered across multiple pages and misses changes to cards that have not been reprinted.

The Amaranth deck builder - amaranth.vtes.co.nz/ - can show the card text changes over time, but that misses some information (for example, the incorrect cost of the CE version of Murder of Crows).

I try to maintain a manual list of errata'd cards at drnlm.org/~neil/VTES/errata/vtes_errata_cards.html , although that has some subjective elements and is still incomplete.
